what: A granular grand piano: the Salamander grand broken into grains. 8 presets with two macros each, smart HOLD, backwards grains, halos, textures (rain, vinyl, sea), MEMORY, PULSE, key pressure and 15 scales, some between the keys.
author: swtdr34mz
